<h2 id="rotations"><ins><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This rotation aims to achieve sub 3:20 minute kills.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Pad order used: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>6 → 2 → 1 → 3 → 4 → 5</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This rotation requires strict adherence to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks and any variation should be adjusted to accordingly.</nowiki></p>
